[ASSISTANT_SAID] Considerations for GPU upgrade:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Power Supply: Recommended 650W or higher PSU.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Motherboard Compatibility: Check PCIe version and slot size.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Cooling: Consider a GPU with a good cooling system or invest in a separate CPU cooler.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Budget: Mid-range GPUs range from $200 to $400.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Game Requirements: Check specific game system requirements.
